entities.name: Jeremiah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: The "weeping prophet" who prophesied the destruction of Jerusalem and the Babylonian Exile (c. 626–586 BCE). Proclaimed the New Covenant (Jeremiah 31:31-34), a key concept in Christian theology. His ministry spans the final decades of the Kingdom of Judah.
